$comment: The Registry (ADR-041). The human deploys it to the production account (docs/DEPLOY.md §6) and puts the v0 signing key in the secret REGISTRY_SIGNING_KEY. REGISTRY_LIMITS caps new registrations (per IP per hour, per contact per day, all per hour); REGISTRY_PAUSE_NEW "1" pauses new registrations only (docs/DEPLOY.md §6.7).
